cluster_metric_rule.denominator: expert-mapped pixels; segmentation partition metrics use only pixels also covered by a positive Bora group; coverage reported separately
cluster_metric_rule.segmentation_adjusted_rand: permutation-invariant adjusted Rand index on expert tissue classes and original anonymous Bora groups
cluster_metric_rule.segmentation_matched_iou: one-to-one Hungarian group-to-expert matching; unmatched expert classes score zero; mean over expert classes present in covered pixels
cluster_metric_rule.identification: for each original group, compare fastPLS predicted class with that group’s majority mapped expert class; group and pixel-weighted accuracy conditional on covered annotated pixels
cluster_metric_rule.end_to_end: existing expert-present macro IoU of the fastPLS-colored final Bora mask, retaining the published denominator
